A little about me...

Hi there, I'm a creative spirit, artist, illustrator, and entrepreneur. I make picture books and am the founder of Fiercely Curious showcasing the work of other artists.

I studied fine art and fashion design which took me to living abroad in Florence, Italy and Paris, France. I traveled cross country for a year and a half with small children, but now we're all settled in Brooklyn, NY.

Apart from making art, I love plants, rock climbing, pickleball and the great outdoors.

Let's make something great together!

Erin Przekop · Brooklyn
